other_conditions: Applicant must be a male construction worker
Must be registered under Haryana Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (HBOCWWB)
Must have a minimum of one‑year regular membership
Wife must have delivered a baby
Wife must not have claimed maternity benefit from any other employer
Benefits are payable for up to two children, expandable up to three daughters irrespective of birth order
All required documents must be submitted within one year of the wife's delivery date
Birth certificate must be attached with the application
benefits_summary: Financial assistance of ₹21,000 (₹15,000 for newborn care and ₹6,000 for wife's nutritious food) per eligible male construction worker.
